title: Miband 4 - Feature Request: More Alarm Features
symptom: The user requests that all alarms be forwarded to the watch to allow muting without touching the phone, and that an option be added to select which alarms are sent. They also note that it is not possible to mute an alarm right away through the watch because the screen takes a few seconds to upload, and they request more detail in the notification text.
fix: The issue is closed as solved in the build available at https://bigdigital.home.blog, but no specific fix details are provided.
evidence_quote: I'll close this issue because it is solved in the build available at https://bigdigital.home.blog.
